refused: blend_breaks_links: other files that link @ob:Cube by its name won't follow the rename: they lose the object. Name that loss with --break-links
next: object rename @obj:2 --name "Box" --break-links

error.message: other files that link @ob:Cube by its name won't follow the rename: they lose the object. Name that loss with --break-links
error.next: Other files link an object by its name, so a rename breaks those links: they lose the object. Nothing was applied. Run the rename again with --break-links to accept that loss.

next_step.why: Rename it, accepting that other files linking it by its old name lose it.
